_documentation: Directory Early-Access announcement (scripts/social-post.py --thread). A single Bluesky post with a clickable link card (app.bsky.embed.external) for /people.html: title + description + the directory OG card as the thumbnail. The URL is NOT in the post text because the card carries it. Dedup key recorded in data/social-posted.json. Compose/verify with --dry-run; publish behind the social environment gate.

posts.text:
👥 Meet the network.

The NetSec Directory is now in Early Access: researchers, policy-makers, and practitioners across European security, filterable by working group, research theme, and country.

Working in the field? Add your bio.

card.title: The NetSec Directory
card.description: An open, searchable directory of the network. Find a mentor, offer to host an STSM, and filter by working group, research theme, or country.
